info.title: triaxis.DuckPg.Cli
info.description: Serves a stack of YAML, JSON and parquet layers over the PostgreSQL wire protocol, backed by DuckDB.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Serves a stack of YAML, JSON and parquet layers over the PostgreSQL wire protocol.

options.name: --pgwire
options.description: Listen address for the PostgreSQL front door. Default 127.0.0.1:55432 unless only --tds is given.

options.name: --key
options.description: Column identifying a row, for tables that name no key of their own. Repeatable.

options.name: --write
options.description: Directory holding the topmost layer, the one that accepts writes.

options.name: --config
options.description: Configuration file. None is read unless one is named.

options.name: --install-duckdb-only
options.description: Download the DuckDB library if none is found, and exit without serving. [default: False]

options.name: --cache
options.description: Directory to write merged copies of multi-layer tables into, as ZSTD parquet. Trades build time and disk for read speed.

options.name: --database
options.description: Database name a client sees itself connected to. Defaults to the schema's.

options.name: --schema
options.description: Schema the published views live in.

options.name: --serialize-transactions
options.description: Let one transaction run at a time, the next waiting for the one in front of it. [default: False]

options.name: --derive-ids
options.description: Give every row its own value for a NEWID() default, derived from its key, rather than one value for the whole run. [default: False]

options.name: --no-check-keys
options.description: Let a write put two rows under one declared key, which is refused by default. [default: False]

options.name: --no-sort-small-tables
options.description: Leave a small materialized table's sorting and limiting to DuckDB, which is on by default. [default: False]

options.name: --compress
options.description: Checkpoint once the lake is built, so DuckDB compresses what it holds in memory. [default: False]

options.name: --store-mode
options.description: Whether the store is the lake's state (keep, the default) or only where its tables live (spill).

options.name: --store
options.description: Hold a materialized lake's tables in this DuckDB database file rather than in memory.

options.name: --lazy
options.description: Collapse a table when a statement first names it, rather than every table at startup. Needs --materialize. [default: False]

options.name: --materialize
options.description: Collapse the layers into real DuckDB tables and serve those; nothing is kept but a delta at shutdown. [default: False]

options.name: --base
options.description: A baked database to serve instead of layers, copied on the way up and never written to. Needs no dacpac, no key and no configuration: the file carries them.

options.name: --writable
options.description: Accept writes without a write directory; they are lost on exit. [default: False]

options.name: --write-format
options.description: Format a table is persisted in when the write layer has no file for it yet.

options.name: --tds-packet-size
options.description: Bytes a TDS packet carries, 512 to 32767. The server's answer to what the client asked for. Default 32767.

options.name: --tds
options.description: Listen address for the TDS front door, which SqlClient speaks.

options.name: --dacpac
options.description: A .dacpac to take column names, order, types and keys from.

options.name: --install-duckdb
options.description: Download the DuckDB library on the way up if none is found, rather than failing. [default: False]

options.name: --verbosity
options.description: Logging level [default: Information]

options.name: -v
options.description: Increase verbosity, equivalent to --verbosity=Debug (-v) or --verbosity=Trace (-vv) [default: False]

options.name: -q
options.description: Decrease verbosity, equivalent to --verbosity=Warning (-q) or --verbosity=Error (-qq) [default: False]

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

arguments.name: LAYERS
arguments.description: Layer directories, lowest first. Overrides the configuration.

commands.name: bake
commands.description: Writes what a stack of layers publishes out as parquet, one file a table. Reading the result is the same lake as reading the layers it came from -- what it saves is parsing them again.

options.name: --out
options.description: Where the bake goes, and what --format defaults to: a path ending in .duckdb is a database and anything else a directory. A directory must be outside the layers.

options.name: --format
options.description: What to write: Parquet for a directory of one file a table, read back as an ordinary layer, or Database for the whole lake as a DuckDB file, served with --base. Taken from the name when unset -- .duckdb is a database and anything else is a directory.

options.name: --block-size
options.description: Block size a baked database is created with, in bytes. Small is what makes a lake of many tables a small file and so a cheap copy; raise it where the tables are big enough for the metadata of small blocks to cost more than the bytes it saves.

options.name: --config
options.description: Configuration file. None is read unless one is named.

options.name: --write
options.description: Directory holding the topmost layer, the one that accepts writes.

options.name: --key
options.description: Column identifying a row, for tables that name no key of their own. Repeatable.

options.name: --dacpac
options.description: A .dacpac to take column names, order, types and keys from.

options.name: --install-duckdb
options.description: Download the DuckDB library on the way up if none is found, rather than failing. [default: False]

arguments.name: LAYERS
arguments.description: Layer directories, lowest first. Overrides the configuration.
